user_report: A tyre warning appeared after parking overnight; right-front reads below the vehicle target.
disclaimer: All values synthetic; values are not recommended pressures or diagnostic thresholds.
safe_response: Do not continue driving on a visibly flat or damaged tyre. Ask about symptoms and refer to vehicle placard/manual; serious deflation requires roadside help.

user_report: The vehicle displayed a high engine-temperature warning while stuck in traffic.
disclaimer: All values synthetic; one temperature number is not a BMW diagnostic cutoff.
safe_response: Advise stopping safely and following owner warning instructions; do not open the cooling system hot. Fan failure is only one possibility.

scenario: Engine cranks but will not start
user_report: I hear the starter turning but the engine will not catch.
disclaimer: Values are synthetic. Battery voltage source in demo must be tagged; no real starter current recorded.
safe_response: Distinguish no-crank from crank-no-start; check VIN-specific starter recalls and request professional help if repeated.

user_report: Brake pedal has become soft; brake-fluid warning is illuminated.
disclaimer: Synthetic report; absence of hydraulic pressure value is not evidence of safe brakes.
safe_response: Do not continue driving; arrange recovery and qualified brake inspection.

user_report: Engine shakes and the malfunction lamp is flashing.
disclaimer: Synthetic readings, no verified live engine data.
safe_response: Stop safely, avoid extended operation, and seek professional assessment. Do not propose replacing parts based on one observation.
